title: Disappointed on a epic level!!
text: Disappointed on a epic level!!. I got this as a gift and really wanted it. Well it's junk. It will hold all the cds yes but you can't close it at all! I wasted all that time putting the cds into it and now I have to find another one to buy that will actually close. So disappointed! I expected better
